rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORanderer
Exhibition name: Kupferkönigin ™
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. Flowers deep yellow; copper yellow upper. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Large foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower, garden or shrub. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
